title: 第三章 上海初试
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

到了上海执行部门口有专门接待的人，先登记了名字，填了一些身份信息个人资料。然后做了个简单的体检。包国维的身体素质不差的，全科都是丁唯独体育是乙，也算是有个特长。

“你是浙江人，浙江考生都安排在这个宿舍，看，那里就是你的床位。”

“谢谢先生。”

晚上的时候还有位先生过来查房，又说了几句话，“这几天都要休息好了，报考军校可是有可能掉脑袋的，不仅仅是当个军官耍耍威风这么简单。”

“为救国救民，我们早把生死置之度外，我们不怕。”

“是，我们不怕。”

两位先生再去另外的宿舍看看。“这上头的宿舍住着的是浙江和安徽的考生。那里边是我老家湖南的考生。”

“你老家湖南好像来了不少考生啊。”

“三湘子弟报国心切，这一趟就来了十八名哩。”

“上海考生的资源都很不错，不过到了广州黄埔，入学考试也是非常严格的。希望我们上海考区的考生能全部录取。”

上海目前只是个初试。通过之后，去广州黄埔再考，层层选拔，颇为严格。

笔试了一场之后开始面试。这一两个月来，包国维看了不少秦老太爷的书，再加上上辈子的记忆，考的那些国文，算数，没有太大的问题，就军事理论或许没那么好，反正也给写满了。

笔试完了又是面试。

考场里头坐着五个面试考官，给人很大压迫感。

一个个考生陆续地进去，包国维还在走廊外面等着被叫名。

“你办过文化书社？”

“是，从上海到南昌以后，我和朋友办了这个书社，介绍进步书刊，宣传的进步思想。”

“我跟你一样，曾经也办过一个文化书社。你读工业学校，那请你谈一谈，工业和中国革命之间有什么联系呢。”

“中国是一个落后的农业国，工业极不发达，我们工作一天的成果，欧洲国家的机器几分钟就能生产出来......

要想改变现状，就要我们自己生产洋钉，洋火，洋灰。”

考官对这位考生很满意：“说的好，你为什么要报考军官学校。”

Page (1/3)

When we arrived at the Shanghai Execution Department, there was a special receptionist. We first registered our names and filled in some identity information and personal data.Then I did a simple physical examination.Bao Guowei's physical fitness is not bad. He is a D in all subjects but a B in physical education. He has a specialty.

"You are from Zhejiang. All candidates from Zhejiang are placed in this dormitory. Look, your bed is there."

"Thank you sir."

In the evening, a gentleman came over to check on the ward and said a few words, "You need to get some rest these days. You may lose your head when you apply for the military academy. It's not just as simple as being an officer and showing off your power."

"In order to save the country and the people, we have put life and death aside for a long time. We are not afraid."

"Yes, we are not afraid."

The two gentlemen went to look at other dormitories."The dormitories above are occupied by candidates from Zhejiang and Anhui. Over there are candidates from Hunan, my hometown."

"It seems like there are a lot of candidates coming from your hometown in Hunan."

"The children of Sanxiang are eager to serve the country, and eighteen of them came this time."

"The resources for candidates in Shanghai are very good, but in Huangpu, Guangzhou, the entrance examination is also very strict. I hope that all candidates from our Shanghai examination area can be admitted."

Shanghai is currently only a preliminary test.After passing the exam, I went to Huangpu, Guangzhou and took the exam again. The selection process was very strict.

After a written test, the interview began.In the past two months, Bao Guowei has read a lot of books by Mr. Qin. Coupled with the memory of his previous life, there is no big problem with the Chinese language exams and arithmetic. The military theory may not be that good, but it is full anyway.

After the written test, it was time for the interview.

There were five interviewers sitting in the examination room, which made people feel very oppressive.

Candidates entered one after another, and Bao Guowei was still waiting outside the corridor to be called.

"Have you ever run a cultural book club?"

"Yes, after arriving in Nanchang from Shanghai, my friends and I set up this book club to introduce progressive books and periodicals and promote progressive ideas."

"Like you, I once ran a cultural book club. You studied in an industrial school, so please talk about the connection between industry and the Chinese revolution."

"China is a backward agricultural country with extremely underdeveloped industry. What we work for a day can be produced by machines in European countries in a few minutes...

If we want to change the current situation, we must produce our own nails, matches, and cement."

The examiner was very satisfied with the candidate: "Well said, why did you apply for the Military Academy?"
